ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) with a regional high-intensity (white) patch on the left lobe; ratio is approximately 80% black to 20% white across the total visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-contrast white patch spanning the distal quarter of the left lobe; multiple small (sub-10 pixel) white circular points distributed across the dark central and right-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a deep convergence point; angle estimated at 35-40 degrees with a significant vertical depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary of both lobes, exhibiting multiple peaks and valleys with amplitudes ranging from 5 to 25 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the lateral edges of both lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, textured barnacle colonies (Coronula spp.) located on the terminal tips of both lobes; numerous circular white scar rings scattered throughout the dark pigment areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible within the dark pigmentation on the medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal margins, particularly concentrated at the left and right tips, creating a prominent irregular edge texture.
